items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 9 at 8:32PM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 8 inches along
portions of the Parks Highway. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may
result in areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough, especially south of Denali Park.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected tonight through
Saturday night. Rain may mix in on Saturday, but roads and
especially bridges are likely to become slick and snow covered.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 9 at 8:32PM AKDT until October 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Snow begins Saturday morning then becomes
heavier Saturday night with total snow accumulations up to 8 inches
by Sunday evening. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may result in
areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Saturday to 4 PM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected late tonight through
Sunday. Roads and especially bridges are likely to become slick and
snow covered.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 9 at 3:54PM AKDT until October 11 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 75 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high
profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 9 at 3:54PM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 75 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds may blow down trees and power lines.
Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
People should avoid being outside in forested areas. Use caution if
you must drive.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 9 at 12:03PM AKDT until October 10 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 10 to 14
inches for areas of elevation. Winds occasionally gusting as high
as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Noatak Valley and South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility.
items.areas: South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range; Noatak Valley
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water with
you in case of an emergency.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 6 at 3:32PM AKDT until October 10 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description: * WHAT...High surf expected. Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the normal high tide line, peaking during high tide.  * WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.  * WHEN...From 7 AM Thursday to 4 AM AKDT Saturday.  * IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur. items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.
